item.description:
Settling In: Your First 30 Days in Anne Arundel County

Welcome to Anne Arundel County! Whether you’re relocating for military service at Naval Academy, Fort Meade, or Joint Base Andrews, working in the DC/Baltimore corridor, or simply seeking Maryland’s coastal lifestyle, this guide will help you navigate your first month in our beautiful county.

Week 1 Priorities: The Essentials

Registering Your Vehicle with Maryland MVA

Getting your out-of-state vehicle registered in Maryland is one of your first legal requirements.

item.title: New Residents Guide: Everything You Need to Know About Moving to Anne Arundel County
item.description:
New Residents Guide: Everything You Need to Know About Moving to Anne Arundel County

Estimated reading time: 6 minutes

Moving to a new place means starting fresh—but it also means figuring out a lot of things you never thought about until you actually need them. As someone who has helped multiple families navigate the move to Anne Arundel County, I’ve learned what actually matters in those crucial first weeks. Let’s walk through what you need to know.

item.title: Anne Arundel County Tax Guide
item.description:
Anne Arundel County Tax Guide

Understanding taxes in Anne Arundel County is essential for budgeting and financial planning. This guide covers property taxes, income taxes, sales taxes, and other tax obligations.

Property Taxes

Anne Arundel County Property Tax

County Tax Rate:

  • Based on assessed value of property
  • Rates change annually
  • Published each fiscal year
  • Different rates for residential and commercial

Assessment Process:

  • Property assessed annually
  • Assessment based on market value
  • Assessment notices sent annually
  • Appeal process available
